case_title: PAPPu v. THE STATE OF UTTAR PRADESH
aggravating_circumstances: brutal rape and murder of a seven-year-old girl child, depravity, shocks the conscience
mitigating_circumstances: no criminal antecedents, very poor socio-economic background, family comprising of wife, children and aged father, unblemished jail conduct
trial_court_outcome: convicted of rape and murder, concealed dead body
neutral_facts: The accused enticed a seven-year-old girl to accompany him on the pretext of picking lychee fruits. Thereafter, he committed rape on her and killed her, then dumped the dead body in bushes near the riverbank. The child witness testified that the deceased was last seen in the company of the accused when he took her along with him while shooing away other children. The accused failed to explain his whereabouts after he was last seen with the deceased and his knowledge about the location of the dead body. The medical and other scientific evidence formed a complete chain of circumstances leading to the conclusion of the accused's guilt. The dead body of the victim child was recovered at a faraway place near the river bank at the instance of the accused. The accused failed to satisfactorily explain his whereabouts since he was last seen in the company of the deceased as also his knowledge of the location of the dead body.
